(ka)༄༅/ /rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la brten pa'i 'chi slu'i cho ga ring 'tsho'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī bantu

tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la brten pa'i 'chi slu'i cho ga ring 'tsho'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī bantu/ yid 'ong zla zhun thig le ni// 'chi med bdud rtsi 'dzag pa yis// dus mun bsnyil nas rtag brtan gyi// lang tsho rgyas mdzad lha des skyongs// de'ang ji skad du/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ 'khor bar srog las gces pa ni// ci yang yod pa ma yin te// de las myur du thabs mang pos// 'chi ba slu ba kun tu spyad// ces gsungs pa ltar mtho ris yon tan bdun gyi gtso bo tshe ring ba nyid yin la/ de la brten nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pas na/ ring 'tsho'i thabs la 'bad pa gal che/ de la thog mar/ phyi rol mtshan ma la brten nas 'tsho 'chi brtag pa dang*/ nang rlung gi 'gro 'ong la brten nas 'tsho 'chi brtag pa gnyis kyis nges pa dang ma nges pa brtag pa'i phyi ma zlog par nus te/ slob dpon gyis/ snum dang snying po zad sogs las// mar me la sogs 'jig phyogs pa'ang*// slar yang snum sogs rab thob pas// bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa yin// ji ltar de bzhin lus 'di yang*// rgas sogs kyis ni 'chi bzhin par// grub pa'i man ngag legs rnyed na// bskal pa'i mthar yang cis mi gnas// dper na khang pa rnying pa dag /bcos pa yis ni yun ring gnas// de bzhin rnying pa'i lus dag kyang*// bcos pas gnas par cis mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe sring ba'i thabs la mkhas shing rtsol ba dang ldan na ring du 'tsho ba la dka' ba yod pa ma yin no// thabs de la'ang slob dpon gyis/ nor bu sngags sman phyi yin te// rnal 'byor nus pa nang yin no// 'bad pas 'chi ba bslu ba ni// dad pa nyid kyis bya bar nus// zhes pa ltar las 'dir sman gyi nus pa sogs las khyad par du 'phags pa'i thabs tshe zad pa la tshe chog

'chi slu/ rlung gi sbyor ba sogs dang*/ las zad pa la srog bslu/ nye'u 'don/ dka' thub la sogs pa dang*/ bsod nams zad pa la mchod pa dang*/ sbyin gtong la sogs pas gso zhing*/ dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len ni thams cad du gal che ba las/ 'dir de dag dang ldan pas 'chi ba slu ba'i cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po dkyil 'khor la dgos pa'i yo byad ba ri lugs sogs sgrol dkar gang la brten pa bzhin dang*/ 'chi slu'i yo byad ni dkyil 'khor gyi shar du slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ bum pa gnyis/ lhor tshe mdo/ nub tu dar dmar la sgrol gzungs sgrol dkar snying po/ gshin rje'i gshed dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring bris pa/ byang du sgrol bstod dang gzungs/ phyogs der ku sha'i gdan la bsgrub bya'i glud gos bltabs pa tshon skud kyis rdo rje rgya gram du bcings ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma bzhi la rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i dar gyi cod pan dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhal phyogs par bsham/ shar du snod gas chag med par 'brang rgyas lha bshos sam nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs zlum po rtse cung rno ba phyed bkas su sbyar ba phyed mar gyis dkar por byugs pa la/ mar gyi lha bshos lnga btsugs pa/ phyed nag por byas pa la dpal 'bar lnga btsugs pa dkar po'i ngos dkyil 'khor la bsten te bzhag slob dpon gyis bum pa'i chu la las sngags a mṛ ta brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i chus bsgrub bya la khrus byas pa'i phyed ni kham phor gsar pa'i nang du blugs nas 'o ma dang dug cung zad bsres pa dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su bzhag phyed kyis sātstsha'am mchod rten rnying pa'i sa dang ro thal/ rdza ma bsregs thal/ dur khrod kyi sa/ tshig ma'i phye ma rnams sa nag dang bsres pa sbrus te/ 'chi bdag gi gzugs khru gang pa mdog nag po ma he'i mgo can rab tu khros shing*/

g.yas ral gri'am thod dbyug g.yon zhags pa nag po thogs pa'i gzugs byas pa/ sla nga'i nang du cung zad kha sbub pa'i tshul du yod par byas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhor re nag gi gdan la dar ras nag pos bkab ste kha lhor bltas su bzhag dkyil 'khor dang de'i bar du rnyed na me tog nag po/ dug sna/ nas sran sogs 'bru nag sha dmar/ mar thud/ bu ram/ tsha la sogs bsres pa'i zas sna/ gser dngul sogs rin po che/ dar ras nor sna gang 'dzom/ de dag 'jal byed kyi bre/ bsgrub bya'i lo grangs ri mo btab pa'i zho cha srang sogs rdzong chas rnams bsham/ gzhan yang nya sha skam po'i spos/ gri so ma/ dug sna phye ma bcas nyer bsdogs bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba/ gshin rje la bya ba/ bsgrub bya'i bya ba'o// dang po ni/ rang nyid sgrub grogs dang bcas pa gdan la 'khod de/ sems can thams cad 'chi bdag gi chad pa las thar bar byas te sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag snyam pa'i sems bskyed kyis zin pas/ sgrol dkar cho ga'i mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ bdag mdun bum gsum rgyal chen bzhi'i ma gtogs pa'i/ gtor 'bul dang bcas pa grub par bya'o/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ bre la/ oṃ aṣmas was tsi swā hā/

'ga' zhig tu/ oṃ aṣmas rbas tsi murti thibs swāhā/ zhes pa'ang byung*/ zhes pa dang*/ srang la/ oṃ thib ta mthong ba'i rgyal po la swā hā/ gser zho dang srang gnyis ka la/ oṃ ma ti pra mo dha na thibs swā hā/ zhes pa rnams lha 'dre mig sgyur gyi sngags te sgra gzhan gyis ma thos par slob dpon gyis nyer gcig re shub bus bzlas te gdab/ de'i tshe gshin rje'i gzugs kyi khebs bsal la zhal dkyil 'khor la bskor te bzhag de nas yo byad thams cad la chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas rdzas kyi skyon rnams sbyang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hās rgyas par spel/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bdud rtsir bsgyur/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥsarba thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐ gis rang rang gang 'dod pa thob par byas/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs manta spha ra ṇa rasmi sambhā wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya swā hās rang dbang du thob par byas/ dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hās mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ sngags de rnams lan gsum gsum brjod do// de nas 'chi bdag gi gzugs la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las las kyi gshin rje mdog nag po ma he'i gdong pa can/ g.yas thod dbyug ral gri byas kyang chog g.yon zhags pa nag po thogs pa/ 'khor bdud rigs bzhi'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur ces dang*/

spro na/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol nas// dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na// thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na// yi dwags kun gyi ded dpon po// ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje bo// gson gshin kun gyi zam kha ba// gson po skos la 'debs pa'o// shi ba rnams kyi gshed bu che// dge ba can gyi stangs 'dzin pa// sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan// legs nyes chos bzhin spyod pa po// chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu rlabs can// 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan 'dren gdangs dbyangs rol mo dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste spyan drangs nas/ 'khor bdud rigs bzhis bskor ba dang bcas pa la thim par bsam zhing hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis 'chi bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas pa che ge mo'i 'chi bslu srog glud len pa la skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas dgug gzhug lan gsum byas te bstim mo// de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i phyag mchog sbyin gyi nang du bsgrub bya bsams la/ de la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ khyad par de nyid kyi thugs ka nas mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pa can du gyur pas/ bsgrub bya'i bla tshe dang bsod nams bdud dang gshin rje mthu chen gyis bcings shing dbang du byas pa thams cad tshur bsdus nas bsgrub bya la thim pas tshe srog nyams pa thams cad sor chud nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam zhing snying po yi ge bcu pa tshe sham can bzla/

de'i tshe sgrub grogs gcig gis lho nas sgrol ma'i gzungs dang tā re tshe sham can/ tshe mdo rnams 'don/ gcig gis byang nas sgrol bstod dang*/ gzungs snying po rnams 'don/ glud gos la nya sha'i dud pas bdug sgrub grogs gzhan rnams kyis kyang gzungs dang snying po tshe sham can 'don zhing*/ tshar re song ba'i rjes la/ nas gro/ sha mar thud/ gser dngul sogs bre grangs/ khal grangs/ zho grangs/ srang grangs rnams re re nas bgrangs pa'i brgya stong sogs bgrang dgos kyang*/ de tsam mi 'grub pas snga ma brgya rtsa'am/ lo grangs sogs sgra ji bzhin pa dang*/ de nas gcig bcu/ brgya/ stong*/ khri/ 'bum/ sa ya/ bye ba/ dung phyur mang po byas te rdzongs 'debs/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing*/ byang gi sgrol bstod sogs 'don mkhan gyis tshar re thon pa dang*/ glud gos tshon skud dang bcas pa la nya sha'i dud pas bdug cing*/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na// po ta la yi zhing khams su// tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo bzhugs// su zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa// dus min 'chi ba las grol nas// ri bo ta lar skye bar 'gyur// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas// nad dang sdug bsngal kun bral nas// tshe sbyin lha mo'i sku thob shog /ces brjod de/ sgrol bstod sogs kyi grangs brgya rtsa gcig gam ma mtha' bsgrub bya'i lo grangs re bya zhing*/ 'di'i skabs su sgrub g.yog rnams kyis kyang gzungs dang snying po 'don pa dang*/ bre srang gis 'jal ba dang*/ grangs brjod pa ma gtogs tha mal gyi gtam gzhan smra mi rung*/ bya ba thams cad don med du 'gyur ba'i rgyur gsungs pas rtsed mo dang gad mo sogs mi bya/ sems kyis chos thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur rten 'brel gyi gzugs brnyan yin/ ji ltar rdzongs byed pa'i rdzas de rnams dngos po bzang zhing rgya che ba 'chi bdag 'khor bcas la byin pas tshim zhing bsgrub bya'i tshe srog bslus par bsams la/

rdzas rnams bre srang dang gser zho la 'jal zhing 'chi bdag gi rdzongs kyi phyir de'i gzugs kyi mdun du dor/ mthar bre srang sogs kyang bcags la dor/ gzungs kyi grangs thims pa dang*/ dpon slob thams cad kyis/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// gshin rje'i mgron la gang byin pa// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// 'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod la/ 'chi bdag gi gzugs la me tog gtor/ de nas rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma bsang sbyang byin brlab 'das gtor bzhin byas nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ e hye hi tsa tur mahā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ dhṛ ta rāṣṭa sogs mtshan sngags bzhi la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod pas mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa sogs kyis bstod/ rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas la sogs nas kun 'grub shog gis phrin las bcol/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'brang rgyas phyed mar gshags te/ nag po ngos la mar me lnga sbar ba dang bsgrub bya bkrus pa'i chu kham phor dang bcas pa gshin rje'i gzugs de'i mdun gyi sla nga'i nang du bzhag ste/ 'brang rgyas sngar byin gyis brlabs zin pa chu gtsang gis sbyang*/ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo sogs kyis gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa la lam brgyags kyi tshul du bsngos/ rang rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'di skad brjod de/ 'di nas lho yi zhes pa nas mthu rlabs can zhes bya ba'i bar dang*/ 'khor bcas 'dir ni bdag la nyon// chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs// 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la// deng 'dir che ge mo zhes pa'i// tshe dang srog gi glud 'bul gyi// 'dod yon rin chen sna lnga dang*/

'bru dang mchod yon sna tshogs dang*// zhal zas me tog la sogs mchod// glud 'di longs la tshe srog byin// bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol// bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig /khyed kyi 'khor gyi yi dwags rnams// bza' ba bzang po 'di 'bul gyi// 'di zo 'khor gyi yi dwags rnams// ma 'tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs// spro na/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la zhes pa nas/ kun 'grub mdzod ces pa'i bar brjod/ de nas rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang nas gdon rnams rang rang gnas su dengs zhes brjod/ de nas dpon slob thams cad bzhengs te slob dpon gyis gshin rje'i sla nga la rdo rjes reg tsam byas nas/ gshin rje kha phyir bstan la rdzongs rnams kyang de'i mdun du 'ong bar byas nas sngar bzhin bden pa bdar te/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis sbyin pa'i bdag po'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol tu song zhig na maḥs manta kā ya wā ktsitta sogs khro bo'i sngags mang du brjod cing rol mo dang bcas pas 'chi bdag gi gzugs dang lhan cig tu rdzongs chas dang gtor ma khrus chu sogs lho phyogs kyi grong zad par skyel la kha lhor bstan te rdzongs chas rnams kyang de'i mdun du bzhag skyel mkhan rnams nang du log dus phyi mig mi blta ba gnad du che'o// gsum pa ni/ bsgrub bya mdun du tsog pur 'khod du bcug la/ glud gos kyi tshon skud bkrol nas/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang dril bu thogs bzhin pas lag len ltar mdud khug btab ste bsgrub bya'i ske dang*/ lag pa'i srin mdzub gnyis dang rkang pa'i mthe bong rnams su bcing*/ nad pa lta bu'i tsog 'dug mi thub pa rnams la g.yon pa kho na la bcings pas btub ces gsungs/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad do// khyed rang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

slob dpon bcom ldan 'das ma tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal ba la mos gus byas pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer rno zhing thogs pa med pa lcags kyu'i rnam pa can grangs med pa 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus kyi phyi nang dang snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la bar du gcod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin par 'chi bar byed pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'od zer sngo dmar dang dud khu sol khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pa can dang*/ gdon bgegs la sogs pa sdig sbal dang srog chags mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can du tshur bkug ste lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud 'di la sib kyis thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pa dang*/ rje btsun rtsa ba sogs kyi bden pa dang gong bzhin brjod pa'i bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bya ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i rgyu nyon mongs pa dug lnga dang*/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i nad rims gdon bgegs mi dang mi ma yin pas byas pa'i byad dang byur sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud sna lnga po 'di la thim par gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang gi lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud 'di nyid nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ ral gri me'i dpal dang chur bcug pa thogs nas/ slob dpon rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mor gsal bas ye shes kyi ral gri me dang chus ngar ldan par byas pa de nyid kyis tshon skud rnams dum bur bcad pas bar du gcod pa thams cad dang bral bar byas par mos pa mdzod ces brjod la 'di skad do// gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*// tshangs pa dang ni 'jig rten skyong*// gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug che// de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa rnams// de dag mthu dang gzi brjid kyis// che ge mo la gnod gyur pa'i// byad stems las rnams chad gyur cig

/oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba bandhā nāṃ ka khorda tstshe da nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing g.yon dril bu dang bcas tshon skud rgyab ngos nas bzung*/ g.yas pas ral gri'i so phyir bstan te mgrin pa'i dang*/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis dang rkang pa gnyis kyi tshon skud rnams bcad/ bcad pa'i dum bus bsgrub bya la phyir bskor zhing bsags/ slar yang las kyi rdo rjes dum bu mang du bcad do// de nas slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon pas tshon skud dum bu bzung*/ g.yas las tshon skud kyi dum bu re re nas snying po dang a mṛ ta brjod cing las bum gyi chu thigs re rnams sngar gyi kham phor 'o chab can gyi nang du dor/ bsgrub bya'i nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bsam zhing lan mang du bya'o// slar yang slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon pas dug sna bzung*/ g.yas pas bsgrub bya'i mgo la bskor zhing chu'i nang du 'dor te/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// zhes dang*/ chos dang dge 'dun la'ang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o// sa ni dug gi pha yin te// sa ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// che ge'i dug ni dug med shog /dug ni sa yi nang du song*// gang ba'i nang du dug song zhig swā hā/ yang spro na/ sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug nges par bcom mo// de bzhin kun la sbyar te/ rang sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis= /dgra bcom pa'i gzi brjid kyis= phyir mi 'ong ba'i= lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i= rgyun du zhugs pa'i= bden par smra ba'i gzi brjid kyis= tshangs pa'i be con gyis= dbang po rdo rjes= khyab 'jug gi 'khor los= me lha'i dpal gyis= chu lha'i zhags pas= lha ma yin gyi rgyud kyis= klu'i rig sngags kyis=

drag po'i mdung rtses= skems byed kyi mdung thung gis dug nges par bcom mo// dug sa'i nang du song zhig de bzhin du sa'i gnas su chu me rlung rnams la'ang 'don pa kha sgyur te brjod mthar khrus chu glud gos dang bcas pa byang phyogs kyi grong zad pa'i sar bskyal lo// de nas skabs 'dir rjes gnang byed na de bzhin dang*/ mi byed na sbyang ba spyi ltar dang*/ bkru byab srung gsum byas la/ slob dpon gyis 'brang rgyas dkar po thogs te/ thams cad kyis phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyi bkra shis brjod cing me tog gtor te bsgrub bya'i lag tu gtad la/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas// snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis bza' bar gyis// 'di zos sangs rgyas tshe dpag med// zhal zas bsten pas nad kun las// grol 'gyur the tshom bya mi dgos// oṃ tā re tutta re tu re ma ma ā yur puṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing slob mas 'brang rgyas bza'o// 'di ni bsgrub bya la dngos su byed pa'i dbang du byas la/ gal te dngos su stabs ma bde na rjes gnang dor ba ma gtogs cho ga gzhan 'dra'o// gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba rnams dkyus ltar bya'o// dal 'byor khang bzang nyams dga' bar// rig pa'i skyes bu bslus pa'i dges// 'gro kun dus min 'chi bdag las// rgyal nas bde bas 'tsho bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rje bla ma de nyid kyi bzhed skong du blo gter dbang pos zhu chen ma hā paṇḍi ta tshul khrims rin chen gyi tshe dpag med lha dgu'i 'chi bslur kha bsgyur nas bris pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
